mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schedule WHERE user_UN = #{user_UN} ORDER BY start_date, start_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (user_UN, title, description, start_date, end_date, start_time, end_time, location, latitude, longitude, mode, color) VALUES (#{user_UN}, #{title}, #{description}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, #{start_time}, #{end_time}, #{location}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{mode}, #{color})
